## Key Facts

- **Target audience**: Foreign MZ FIT travelers (20-35) visiting Seoul/Korea
- **Coverage**: 106+ curated guides as of 2026-05-16
- **Languages**: Korean + English (web pages); Chinese + Japanese (PDF only)
- **Update frequency**: Weekly
- **Data sources**: Naver Maps + Reddit r/koreatravel + Google reviews + user curation
- **Contact**: @keychingu.korea (Instagram)
